intent.notes: The weekly try-hard session on lead: 8-10 min of practice falls right after the warm-up, then two lead routes, each with one technique rule declared on the ground and climbed to the last clip — fall rather than take. Routes at or below your onsight: this is commitment and technique under pump, not a finger-hard session. Needs a gym with rope routes and a trusted belayer.

modules.notes: Practice falls straight after the warm-up, while fresh. Strict pin: without rope routes the block fails instead of turning into a boulder drill.

prescription_overrides.notes: 8-10 min of falls with your usual belayer: 3 rounds of 3 falls, stepping up from just above the clip to a normal lead fall. Push away from the wall, feet facing it, knees soft. Note your fear 0-10 once.

modules.notes: Route 1 of 2: footwork rule above the bolt.

prescription_overrides.notes: Route 1: a vertical small-edge route 2-3 grades below your onsight. Rule declared on the ground: every foot loaded and still for 3 s before a hand moves, above the bolt too. Climb to the top — if you come off, it is a fall, not a take. Log foot slips.

modules.notes: Route 2 of 2: one technique rule kept under pump.

prescription_overrides.notes: Route 2: a steeper route at onsight-1 to onsight, never above (above onsight it becomes a finger-hard session). Declare ONE rule before leaving the ground: clip from a straight arm with the hip in, or feet still and hips under before shaking out. Commit to every move to the last clip — fall, do not take. Log: rule kept yes/no, attempt outcome (SEND / FALL / TAKE / LET_GO).
